test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the value of left{ ( (1)/(3) )⁻² - ( (1)/(2) )⁻³ right} div ( (1)/(4) )⁻² + left{ ( (-3)/(2) )⁴ times ( (5)/(3) )⁴ right} .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(1/3)⁻² = 9 and (1/2)⁻³ = 8

{9 − 8} ÷ (1/4)⁻² = 1 ÷ 16 = 1/16

(-3/2)⁴ × (5/3)⁴ = [(−5/2)]⁴ = 625/16

Total = 1/16 + 625/16 = 626/16

**∴ Answer = 313/8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

{ (1/3)⁻² − (1/2)⁻³ } ÷ (1/4)⁻² + { (−3/2)⁴ × (5/3)⁴ }

**Formula Used:**

a−ⁿ = 1/aⁿ, (a/b)ⁿ × (c/d)ⁿ = [(ac)/(bd)]ⁿ

**Calculation:**

{ (1/3)-2 − (1/2)-3 } ÷ (1/4)-2 + { (−3/2)4 × (5/3)4 }

⇒ (3² − 2³) ÷ 4² + [ (−3/2 × 5/3)⁴ ]

⇒ (9 − 8) ÷ 16 + (−5/2)⁴

⇒ 1 ÷ 16 + 625/16

⇒ 626/16

⇒ 313/8

**∴ The correct answer is 313/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Negative Powers

a−ⁿ = 1/aⁿ

Power Multiplication

(a/b)ⁿ × (c/d)ⁿ = [(ac)/(bd)]ⁿ

Even Power

Negative base becomes positive when power is even
